{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Unique patient_id: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")

duplicates = df[df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)]
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id rows: {len(duplicates)}")

# Check how many patients are duplicated
print(f"Number of patients with multiple rows: {duplicates['patient_id'].nunique()}")"}
